meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Offices, loan accounts and credit outstanding by district and population group, by place of sanction, as on 31 March (latest year)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1145 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. A fourth amount column the mirror does not name is left out.
